title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00084 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: Skidded BOP from well center to test stump.
01:15 - 02:00: Removed scaffolding in moonpool
02:00 - 02:15: Performed TBT for removing hatches
02:15 - 03:45: Rigged up lifting equipment and removed hatch covers and split hatches from f-15.
03:45 - 04:00: Performed TBT for pulling surface HP riser
04:00 - 04:45: Rigged up lifting arrangement with double securing. Disconnected surface HP riser from multibowl and pulled riser to drill floor.
04:45 - 05:00: Installed master bushing
05:00 - 05:30: L/d surface HP riser. Cleaned seal face and protected same.
05:30 - 06:30: Installed hatches on f-15 and prepared to skid over to f-7.
06:30 - 07:15: M/u nt2 connector on test stump and removed scaffolding. Removed bridge from production unit to cantilever. Cleaned and cleared moonpool
07:15 - 09:00: Continued removing scaffolding in moonpool. Meanwhlie pulled cement hoses from wellhead to moonpool. Loosened bolts on f-7 hatch. End of reporting
